text:
incident-bot: PAGER — Hosted API p99/p95 spike (us-west-2). Request queue growth -> GPU allocation failing. Autoscaler attempts pending; many requests timing out. Paging oncall.

erin: I'm on pager. Observing steady queue growth and p99 spike to ~6s. Any obvious degradations? :eyes:

sam: Provisioner logs show repeated allocation errors — `quotaExceeded` on GPU instance type. Autoscaler keeps retrying but cloud returns 429/Quota. Queue grows while retries backoff.

jess: Runtime reporting hotpath throttle on large-context models; smaller contexts still process. Can we route to lower-memory model to reduce GPU slots?

maria: Customer-impact: a few paying customers seeing 5xxs and timeouts; CS already triaging. We should enable emergency rate-limits for free tiers and non-critical routes.

leo: I'll draft a short status for affected customers. Need ETA for mitigation to include.

sam: Quick mitigation options:
- force-provision extra nodes via console (if quota approves)
- switch heavy routes to quantized-L model (less GPU RAM)
- enable conservative global rate-limit for non-enterprise tenants

erin: Trying route-level fallback to quantized-L for `/v1/generate` heavy routes now. Pushing config.

jess: +1 for fallback. Patch sent to routing: set model-fallback policy to `quantized-L` with soft-threshold 200ms. If that fails, cascade to CPU-embedder (degraded but keeps calls alive).

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook snippet: "When autoscaler reports cloud quotaExceeded: 1) check cloud quota usage, 2) open emergency quota request, 3) temporary scale-down heavy routes, 4) force-provision only after quota check." Link: https://redwood.runbooks/alloc-quota

sam: Paste of relevant provisioner log (latest):

```
provisioner: request tx=0x8f2d alloc GPU g4dn.xlarge -> error: quotaExceeded
provisioner: retry backoff=8s
autoscaler: desired=24 available=16 allocating=0 pending=8
cloud: 429 TooManyRequests {"message":"You have exceeded quota for GPU instances"}
```

erin: Running `kubectl get pods -n hosted | grep provisioner` — provisioner is healthy but allocation loops. Also `aws service-quotas get-service-quota` shows vCPU & GPU quotas at limit.

jess: If quota uplift will take >30m, do fallback then forced soft-throttle. I'll prepare a config change to reduce per-request max-tokens and enable prefix caching to cut token cost.

maria: CS wants a conservative ETA to update customers. Erin, can you give a 30m/1h/3h triage split based on actions?

erin: Current plan:
- 0-10m: enable model fallback for heavy routes (doing now) — expected 50% immediate Q reduction
- 10-30m: apply global soft rate-limit for non-enterprise tenants (reduces burst)
- 30-90m: attempt emergency quota request + coordinate with cloud team. If denied, force-provision smaller instances via multi-az (may require cross-account quotas)

leo: Noted. I'll send an interim customer notification at T+15m with status and mitigation steps.

sam: Manual forced-provision attempt blocked by quota on account A. Trying alternate account B for ephemeral capacity.

ops-runbook-bot: Checklist update:
- [x] Enable model fallback
- [ ] Global soft rate-limit
- [ ] Quota request submitted
- [ ] Forced-provision (if allowed)

jess: Pushing route change now. Route `prod:/v1/generate` -> primary `redwood-L` fallback `quantized-L`. Rolling in 3s batches.

erin: Observing queue depth drop ~30% since fallback applied. p95 down from 2.1s -> 1.4s. p99 still high due to stuck inflight on large tokens.

maria: CS update sent. Customers asked for ETA; gave conservative 1-2h window while we try quota and forced-provision.

sam: Cloud quota team responded: can provision +4 GPUs in 45-60m if we provide justification and immediate uplift. They recommend we use spare cross-account capacity if urgent.

erin: Initiating cross-account provision now. If that fails, enact soft-throttle to 30rps global for non-enterprise.

jess: Added prefix KV cache to reduce repeat token cost for chat-like routes. Expect additional 10-15% throughput gain.

sam: Cross-account provision succeeded for 2 nodes (partial). Autoscaler now sees `allocating=2`. Queue growth stalled.

erin: Great. We're seeing queue drain to normal within the next 10m window. Watch p99 and timeouts.

leo: Sending follow-up to customers: mitigation in-progress, partial capacity added, degraded quality for heavy models but endpoints online.

maria: Filing incident ticket for RCA — root cause looks like unexpected campaign from a 3rd-party causing sustained high-concurrency on heavy-model endpoints, combined with near-limit cloud quotas.

ops-runbook-bot: Incident status: mitigation in-progress. Next steps: postmortem owners, quota audit, routing policy adjustment.

erin: I’m handing off oncall at T+90m to sam (rotation). Sam will lead postmortem and coordinate quota changes with cloud team.

sam: Taking over. Will coordinate with infra to request permanent quota increases and create automated fallback that engages earlier at 60% GPU capacity.

jess: Follow-ups: bake routing fallback into CI, add telemetry to alert at 50% sustained queue growth, and add a one-click cross-account provision runbook.

leo: I'll follow up with CS to escalate to any impacted enterprise customers if needed. Thanks everyone.

erin: Leaving notes in incident channel. Marking as mitigated when queue stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:
